findings.note: plan.mjs line 333 falls back to containing(d, m.startLine).newStart when oldToNew has no entry; this assumes the line always lies inside a hunk's old range. The invariant appears sound by construction (hunks partition the diff) and is covered by the diff-vectors.json shared test suite, but a future change to lineDiff's hunk assembly could silently reintroduce an undefined dereference here with no local guard.
